panels.title: Uptime - History
panels.description: Historical uptime for each server. After a server restarts, its uptime returns close to zero. Historical data is available from the moment Prometheus started collecting metrics.

targets.expr: (pterodactyl_server_cpu_absolute{server_name=~"$server"} * on (server_name, id, job, instance) group_left (cpu_limit) (label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (server_name, id, job, instance) ("cpu_limit", pterodactyl_server_max_cpu_absolute{server_name=~"$server"} @ end()), "cpu_limit", "$1%", "cpu_limit", "^(.+)$"), "cpu_limit", "unlimited", "cpu_limit", "^0%$") > bool 0)) or on (server_name, id, job, instance) label_replace(pterodactyl_server_cpu_absolute{server_name=~"$server"}, "cpu_limit", "unavailable", "server_name", ".*")

panels.title: CPU usage / limit
panels.description: One row and line per server. Last shows CPU usage (e.g. 240%), with the limit in the legend (e.g. 500%). Unlimited servers (limit 0) are included as 'unlimited'; usage remains visible if the limit metric is missing. The limit is taken at the end of the selected time range.

panels.title: CPU usage percent
panels.description: Percentage of the configured CPU limit in use (absolute usage / limit × 100): for example, 200% out of 400% = 50%. No value for servers with unlimited CPU (limit 0).

targets.expr: (pterodactyl_server_memory_mebibyte{server_name=~"$server"} * on (server_name, id, job, instance) group_left (memory_limit) (label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (server_name, id, job, instance) ("memory_limit", pterodactyl_server_max_memory_mebibyte{server_name=~"$server"} @ end()), "memory_limit", "$1 MiB", "memory_limit", "^(.+)$"), "memory_limit", "unlimited", "memory_limit", "^0 MiB$") > bool 0)) or on (server_name, id, job, instance) label_replace(pterodactyl_server_memory_mebibyte{server_name=~"$server"}, "memory_limit", "unavailable", "server_name", ".*")

panels.title: Memory usage / limit (MiB)
panels.description: One curve and legend row per server: used amount in the graph and Last column, configured limit in the legend (0 = unlimited).

targets.expr: (pterodactyl_server_disk_mebibyte{server_name=~"$server"} * on (server_name, id, job, instance) group_left (disk_limit) (label_replace(label_replace(count_values by (server_name, id, job, instance) ("disk_limit", pterodactyl_server_max_disk_mebibyte{server_name=~"$server"} @ end()), "disk_limit", "$1 MiB", "disk_limit", "^(.+)$"), "disk_limit", "unlimited", "disk_limit", "^0 MiB$") > bool 0)) or on (server_name, id, job, instance) label_replace(pterodactyl_server_disk_mebibyte{server_name=~"$server"}, "disk_limit", "unavailable", "server_name", ".*")

panels.title: Disk usage / limit (MiB)
panels.description: One curve and legend row per server: used amount in the graph and Last column, configured limit in the legend (0 = unlimited).

panels.title: Network Traffic RX - Current (Mbps)
panels.description: Average inbound network speed per server in Mbps, over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Network Traffic TX - Current (Mbps)
panels.description: Average outbound network speed per server in Mbps, over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Network Traffic RX / TX - Current (Mbps)
panels.description: Inbound (RX) and outbound (TX) speed in Mbps: two distinct series per server, averaged over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: Network RX - Cumulative
panels.description: Cumulative inbound traffic per server (bytes, automatically scaled to MiB/GiB).

panels.title: Network TX - Cumulative
panels.description: Cumulative outbound traffic per server (bytes, automatically scaled to MiB/GiB).

panels.title: Network RX / TX - Cumulative
panels.description: Cumulative RX and TX traffic: two separate series per server (bytes, automatically scaled to MiB/GiB).

panels.title: Network Traffic Total - Current (RX + TX, Mbps)
panels.description: Combined RX + TX speed for the displayed servers in Mbps (5-minute moving average).

panels.title: Network Traffic Total - Cumulative (RX + TX)
panels.description: Combined cumulative RX + TX traffic for all displayed servers in bytes. Counters can reset when individual servers restart.

panels.title: Network Traffic Total - Lifetime (RX + TX)
panels.description: Combined RX + TX traffic since persistent accounting was enabled. The total survives server and exporter restarts while the state file is retained. Visible chart history depends on Prometheus retention.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (id) (pterodactyl_server_backup_count{server_name=~"$server"}) / clamp_min(max by (id) (pterodactyl_server_backup_limit{server_name=~"$server"}), 1) and on (id) (max by (id) (pterodactyl_server_backup_limit{server_name=~"$server"}) > 0)

panels.title: Backup - Last Backup and Limits
panels.description: Latest backup, backup usage, and full UUID for each server. A limit of 0 means backups are disabled; negative limits (if supported by the provider) are displayed as unlimited.
